privacy.text:
[date-a] 08:45 FROM: XXXXXXXXXX TO: PA DEPT P.0801/002
[name] CLINICAL [name] (fictional) | LETTER OF MEDICAL NECESSITY
DATE: [date-b] | TO: Prior Authorization Department | FAX: XXXXXXXXXX
PATIENT: [name] [name] (fictional) | DOB: XX/XX/XXXX (Age: 39)
MEMBER ID: XXXXXXXX | PRESCRIBER: Dr. [name] [name], MD (fictional)
RE: Prior Authorization for Humira (adalimumab)
Indication: Moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis (ICD-10 L40.0)
Requested Regimen: Adalimumab 88 mg SQ every 2 weeks
Dear Reviewer,
I am requesting coverage of Humira 88 mg every 2 weeks for [name] [name]
(fictional), a 39-year-old male with moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis.
The patient previously tried and failed methotrexate with inadequate
response, but chart details regarding exact start dates and BSA scores
from the outside clinic were unavailable at the time of transfer.
Most recent clinical assessment documented body surface area of 12%.
Note to reviewer: Requesting higher maintenance dose of 88 mg due to BMI.
Sincerely,
Dr. [name] [name], MD (fictional) | NPI: XXXXXXXXXX
[date-c] 08:45 FROM: XXXXXXXXXX TO: PA DEPT P.0802/002
[name] CLINICAL [name] (fictional) | EHR PROGRESS NOTE & LABS
Patient: [name] [name] (fictional) | Age: 39 | MRN: XXXXXXXX
Date: [date-d] | Provider: Dr. [name] [name], MD (fictional)
ASSESSMENT: Moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis, active flaring.
CLINICAL EVALUATION RECORD:
Evaluation Date | Parameter | Finding | Threshold
i te ee ety
[date-e] | Body Surface Area | 12% | >= 10%
[date-f] | Plaque Morphology | Thick | Scaling
[date-g] | TB QuantiFERON Gold | Negative | Negative
MEDICATION TRIAL SUMMARY :
1. Methotrexate: Chart notes "failed methotrexate due to lack of efficacy”.
No specific dosage, baseline BSA, or follow-up BSA recorded.
2. Topical clobetasol 0.05% cream: Minimal temporary improvement.
PLAN:
Start adalimumab 88 mg subcutaneous injection every 2 weeks.
Dr. [name] [name], MD (fictional) [date-h] 89:15
